title: Baseline Shuffle Shooting
description: Shooters slide along the baseline from corner to short corner and back, catching and shooting on the move from a passer at the elbow.

content.objective: Catch and shoot along the baseline while moving, setting the feet quickly from a lateral slide.
content.setup: Passer at the right elbow; shooter in the right corner.
content.organization: Shooter shoots 8, then swaps with the passer.
instructions: The shooter slides from the corner toward the short corner.
The passer passes; the shooter plants and shoots.
Next rep: slide back to the corner, catch and shoot.
coachingPoints: Slide, do not cross the feet.
Plant the outside foot to stop the slide.
Square the shoulders on the catch.
commonMistakes: Facing the backboard instead of the rim in the short corner.
content.safety: Shooters rebound their own ball only when the lane is clear; nobody stands under the rim while others shoot.
progressions: Defender shadows the shooter on the baseline.
Corner shots from behind the arc.
variations: Pass from the wing instead of the elbow.
Shoot off a skip pass from the other wing.
successCriteria: Feet set before release on most reps.
content.gameApplication: Baseline shooters find gaps behind zones and help defenses.
